items.name: pilgrim's woe petals
items.eat_message: Dry and slightly chalky. A faint warmth follows.
items.description: Dried petals from the pilgrim's woe flower, stripped from the dark fronds. Pale as old linen. The smell is faintly medicinal.

items.name: Crow Bile
items.description: A small dark sac. What the crow has processed through it is unclear. The fluid inside is extremely bitter and faintly luminous.

items.name: Wight Essence Residue
items.description: A crystalline deposit found in the chest cavity. The thing that inhabited the body left this behind when it departed. What inhabited it is unclear. What it wanted is less clear still.

items.name: prophet's eye cap
items.eat_message: Tasteless. Something shifts at the edge of sight for a moment, then is gone.
items.description: A pale, watery mushroom cap. The alchemists prized it. The cap alone is worthless — the liquid inside is what they wanted.

items.name: Resonant Bone Fragment
items.description: A splinter of something old. The tone in it is audible if you press it against your skull and hold still. Do not hold it near bells.

items.name: Oil Lantern
items.description: A small iron vessel with a wick. Burns cleaner than a torch and longer. The light it produces is steadier and somehow less reassuring.
